源图与风格参考：第二张图怎样帮助房间重绘确定方向

风格转换可以把眼前的房间变成另一种材质、配色和光照的视觉提案。两张图一起使用时，先让源图回答「这是哪个空间」，再让参考图帮助说明「想要什么气氛」，最后核对重绘有没有把空间也换掉。

style conversion · neural redraw

风格转换可以把眼前的房间变成另一种材质、配色和光照的视觉提案。两张图一起使用时，先让源图回答「这是哪个空间」，再让参考图帮助说明「想要什么气氛」，最后核对重绘有没有把空间也换掉。

先记住这几件事

  • 源图提供需要保留的房间，风格参考提供可讨论的视觉方向。
  • 本次室内工作流使用风格和房间类型选项，不是任意填写一整段 prompt 的通用编辑器。
  • 现有 FAQ 提醒几何可能漂移，没有公布文字与参考图冲突时的固定优先级。
  • 历史样例改变了建筑开口；今天新提交的任务仍在排队，不能冒充又一次成功结果。

第二张图解决的是表达问题

只说「温暖」或者「自然」，不同人可能想到完全不同的房间。有的人指向墙面颜色，有的人关心木材，有的人想要低反差的光。放入一张参考图，可以让讨论落到吊灯、织物、木色和明暗关系这些看得见的东西上。

这就是本篇讨论的 A 能力线：DLSS 5 风格转换与神经渲染重绘。它把原有空间转成可供讨论的视觉参考；Studio 是交付形态。这里的任务不是处理一张技术质量差的照片，而是试探它可以呈现什么视觉方向。

落点选在室内风格转换页，因为实际素材、现有选项和比较对象都是房间。不能因为双参考听起来通用，就借这组室内图顺便证明换衣服或者换脸也同样可靠。

第一张图先把空间交代清楚

在挑选风格之前，先看源图有哪些开口、墙角和地面关系。哪些地方必须保住，应该先写进验收说明。否则生成图摆上漂亮家具以后，原来那扇门有没有消失，很容易被整体气氛掩盖。

本次源图里，后墙有门，旁边有深色开口，地面还能看到设备和线缆。我们据此比较空间关系，没有根据照片估算房间面积，也没有把透视图当作施工尺寸表。

源图的作用不只在生成时。结果返回以后，它还是判断是否改变空间的依据。把它删掉，只留一张「效果图」，接手的人就很难知道哪扇窗是真实存在，哪扇窗只是模型补出来的。

第二张图让风格有具体参照

这里的参考图包含编织灯罩、灰色沙发、浅色织物、植物和木质表面。它们共同形成一套可讨论的视觉关系。引用这张图，并不等于要求把其中的沙发摆位、窗户和拱形开口照搬到源房间。

站点展示记录把第二张图的职责描述为引导配色与材质。这是工作流希望它承担的角色，不是模型不可能越界的保证。素材包保存了原记录，也保存了实际图，读者可以同时核对文字意图和视觉结果。

可以先在说明里指出你关心的是灯具的材质感、低饱和配色，还是织物与木材的搭配。这是帮助人理解创作意图的方法。本文没有做过把每项元素单独开关的对照实验，不能宣称其中某一项在模型里有独立权重。

prompt 在这个入口里究竟是什么

讨论 prompt 之前，要先看工具实际让人填什么。当前室内工作流接受命名风格和房间类型，也支持把可选补充要求接到固定描述后面。它并不是这次可以任意输入长段提示词的通用编辑界面。

今天真实提交的是 Japandi 风格和 living_room 房间类型，没有填写额外要求，没有指定种子或者输出尺寸。请求记录保留了这些字段，不能为了把文章写得像教程，再补一段从来没提交过的「推荐参数」。

文字承担说明方向或约束的职责，参考图承担提供视觉内容的职责。这个分工可以帮助组织需求，但不等于我们知道模型内部怎样分配两者权重。本文没有测出可量化的控制比例，也没有相应调节旋钮的实验结果。

作为背景，BFL 的图像编辑文档介绍文字和图像共同参与编辑的方式；多参考说明介绍组合参考内容的概念。这两份资料不能替本站的室内模型制定冲突优先级，文中也没有使用它们的样张。

文字和参考图打架时，不能凭空定谁赢

核对过的室内 FAQ 没有写「文字优先」或者「参考图优先」。相关回答是：工作流要求保留房间几何，但生成结果仍可能漂移，分享前应检查直线、开口和透视。另一个回答明确区分视觉概念与真实平面图，涉及尺寸和家具适配时仍需测量资料。

因此，这里能给出的产品边界是「没有已公布的固定优先级可据」，不能把保留几何的要求改写成模型一定服从的规则。如果参考图带有拱门，而源图并没有，输出出现拱门后，应当按源图和任务要求判定偏离，而不是事后解释成系统理所当然选择了参考图。

在编辑工作上，可以先把相互矛盾的需求写清楚，再决定结果能否交给别人。哪些空间特征必须保留，哪些只是气氛启发，应该分开描述。这个建议约束的是人的验收，不是为模型发明一套没有依据的优先级。

历史样例有用，但不能把偏差藏起来

站点已有展示记录把上述两张输入与一张 Japandi 输出关联起来。下面展示的是那张历史输出，不是今天排队任务的结果。我们没有把记录里的耗时或尺寸当成本次刚测出的数字，也没有声称重新生成会得到同一张图。

从画面看，输出采用了与参考图相关的编织灯具、家具和材质气氛。但它还出现了左侧大窗、右侧拱形开口，和源图后墙的门及开口关系不同。只凭整体看起来像一个合理客厅，不能宣布建筑保留通过。

原展示说明对几何保留的表述比实际图片能够支持的结论更强。本文保留原记录用于溯源，不沿用那句判断。源图与风格参考必须跟结果一起看，正是为了发现这种文字说明与可见证据之间的落差。

这张输出仍然可以帮助讨论配色和材质，不过用途应当写成视觉气氛参考。如果下一步需要讨论真实房间怎么装修，必须把建筑变化单独排除，不能让它悄悄成为空间设计的事实依据。

本次真正做过的复现步骤

  1. 保存站内空房间图和风格图，分别作为第一、第二输入；素材包提供实际副本与哈希。
  2. 使用既有 interior-quality 工作流上传两张图，保持源房间在前、参考图在后。
  3. 提交 japandi 与 living_room 两个实际选项，不额外编写 prompt、种子或尺寸。
  4. 保存任务标识并查询状态；本次最后保存的状态是 QUEUED，没有拿到可验收的新输出。
  5. 将历史源图、参考图和历史输出放在同一检查页，复查上文指出的配色与建筑差异。

请求记录把临时上传标识替换为本地文件名，方便读者看清输入顺序；任务记录保留实际任务标识。这份记录证明提交过程发生过，不证明生成已经完成。重新提交需要服务访问权限，也可能消耗额度，不能把它写成无条件免费复现。

此外，我们实际运行了内容库已有的 reproduce-capture.mjs，把本地检查页保存为浏览器截图。执行日志与文件清单随稿保留。这个过程复现的是查看历史素材的环境，不会让排队任务自动完成，也不等于又跑了一次模型。

给下一位使用者留下明确用途

交付视觉提案时，可以写出允许参考的部分，例如编织灯具与墙面之间的气氛关系；再写出不应继承的部分，例如变化后的窗洞和房间布局。这样使用者能够继续推进风格讨论，同时保留对真实空间的判断依据。

源图与风格参考也能帮助定位争议。某个元素究竟来自原房间、参考图还是生成解释，三张图放在一起比只有一句「不是我想要的」更容易核实。这里的价值是让风格转换可讨论、可复查，而不是把每张生成图直接盖章。

本文不承诺换装或换脸的商业可用性，也没有做过人脸保持测试。若自己的授权素材里有人，必须另外核对脸部特征和身份，并让相关人物复核；房间案例不能替人物任务提供证据。

边界与独立性

这套流程不能认证施工尺寸、家具适配、建筑完全不变、人脸身份或者商业适用性，也没有已证实的通用 prompt 优先级。我们运营文中链接的站点，与 NVIDIA、AMD、Black Forest Labs 无隶属关系。本篇讨论独立静态风格转换，使用站内自有素材，不是游戏运行时截图或第三方产品效果测试。

NVIDIA Broadcast 2.3：4K 升频背后的图片检查问题

介绍 4K 视频升频和帧生成功能的报道只有在图片流程被单独展示时才有价值。本文用站点自有图对和可检查的清单给出一个受控回答。

image workflow · entry-point

介绍 4K 视频升频和帧生成功能的报道只有在图片流程被单独展示时才有价值。本文用站点自有图对和可检查的清单给出一个受控回答。

我们要交付的是 DLSS 5 Studio 桌面版，主线是将已有画面按目标风格重绘成 DLSS 5 风格的视觉参考。Broadcast 新闻在这里引出的，只是已有图片质量不足时的附带检查入口，不代表产品身份，也不能充当风格转换的效果证明。

要点

  • 热点提供时间背景，样例负责实际检查。
  • 原图、结果和图注要放在一起。
  • 记录尺寸、操作、日期，不用猜。
  • 结果是视觉参考，不是基准测试。

来源说了什么、没说什么

目标关键词是 NVIDIA Broadcast 2.3 4K upscaling。它真正对应的问题是：图片经过信息流、导出或工具处理后变软，读者还能怎样检查发生了什么。

落点页面是 /image-upscaler，那里把浏览器路径写成独立视觉流程。它不是驱动下载，也不声称属于 Broadcast 相关报道 中提到的公司。

第一条来源是 NVIDIA Broadcast product information（https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce/broadcasting/broadcast-app/）。它提供 Broadcast 相关报道 的背景，图片操作的证据仍来自我们的样例文件。

第二条来源是 NVIDIA newsroom（https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce/news/）。读者可以直接核对上下文，不必只相信本文的转述。

输入才是证据

热点标题能解释为什么有人搜索 Broadcast 相关报道，却不能替代图片许可。我们使用站点自有文件，并保留原文件名，让图对有清楚出处。

这个角度最值得看的不是夸张的风景或标志，而是一条普通边缘：建筑线、产品轮廓，或者压缩后出现块状痕迹的小区域。

先打开低清输入。读几处小字，看重复纹理，再记下自己从哪里开始不再信任图像。这一步发生在增强之前，也应留在记录里。

运行一次浏览器样例，把结果和输入放在一起。不要中途更换输入，否则 NVIDIA Broadcast 2.3 4K upscaling 就不能作为同一个检查复现。

一次可复现运行

两张图要用相同显示宽度。结果图更大时本来就容易显得更抢眼，所以需要稳定的查看框和写清文件名的图注。

记录操作、输入尺寸、输出尺寸和日期。没有记录的字段就写未记录，不用估算填满表格。缺失字段本身就是限制。

如果脸、招牌或文字改变了含义，就以原图作判断依据。视觉增强可以让边缘更容易检查，却不能恢复 介绍 4K 视频升频和帧生成功能的报道 中原本不存在的事实。

对开发者来说，最有用的是请求清单。它说明操作者控制哪个端点、读取哪些文件、把结果写在哪里，不把供应商密钥藏进示例命令。

应该保留的失败

对设计师来说，最有用的是带图注的并排裁剪。裁剪应回答具体问题，比如斜线是否连贯，重复图案是否被抹平。

对研究者来说，最有用的是可重复条件。能固定种子、提示词、分块尺寸、导出格式或节点图时就固定；只有想找原因时才改变一个条件。

这就是 NVIDIA Broadcast 2.3 4K upscaling 作为工作流词的意义。关键词指向可尝试的任务，文章记录一次受控样例和仍然未知的部分。

图注说明可见内容，图对不承担无声的性能承诺，也不隐藏比较条件。

如何交接

本页不提供命令行工具。示例命令只向操作者自己控制的端点发送请求，不消耗本站托管额度，也不冒充厂商基准。

测试自己的图片时，只处理你有权处理的文件。客户没有同意上传时就留在本地，并保留未改动的源文件。

从 Broadcast 相关报道 得出的耐用结论很克制：让变化可见，让来源可追踪，把失败也写下来。这比用一张好看的裁剪图承诺普遍效果更有用。

读者可按下面编号步骤复现，再打开 图片放大页面 查看缓存样例。在线路径和桌面申请路径可用条件不同，文案里不要混成同一个运行时。

来源与声明

这是独立项目，与 NVIDIA、Adobe、Tesla、Topaz Labs、ComfyUI 均无关联。名称只用于指出来源主题，不代表赞助、背书或共同所有权。

边界写清楚：本文不发布帧率，不承诺固定画质变化，也不把一组图对变成硬件测试。它记录的是可以检查的图片操作。

Broadcast 专题清单

Broadcast 报道常把摄像头、视频和游戏语境放在一起。做检查前先分开这些场景。视频导出的静帧可能带着运动模糊和压缩痕迹，这些不一定来自原始画面。这里是静态图检查，不应写成对 Broadcast 的实时测量。

如果输入来自视频，就选一帧能读清边缘的画面，并记录时间点。不要故意挑最糊的一帧来制造夸张前后差异。看到相同原始片段的第二位读者，应当也能理解为什么选它。

交接时最好留一张小表：源文件名、源尺寸、导出格式、操作、结果文件名和变化说明。表格和图对放在一起，文章与图片才不会逐渐失配。

这样读者可以真正试用 image-upscaler 页面，却不需要借用 NVIDIA 账号，也不会把浏览器样例冒充 Broadcast。将来若有新证据，还能另做有来源的比较。

复现步骤

  1. 打开图注中写明的站点自有输入。
  2. 按本主题流程运行一次，按日期保存输出。
  3. 在相同显示尺寸下比较两份文件。
  4. 记录尺寸、操作、来源和一条限制。

crimson desert · crimson desert dlss · crimson desert performance · dlss 4.5 · 绯红荒漠优化

《绯红荒漠》于 2026 年 3 月 19 日发布，成为近年来视觉最具野心的开放世界游戏之一。

支持的超分辨率技术

  • NVIDIA DLSS 4（所有 RTX 显卡）
  • NVIDIA DLSS 4.5（注意：有闪烁 bug，建议使用 DLSS 4 直到修复）
  • AMD FSR 3（任意显卡）
  • AMD FSR 4（仅限 RDNA 4）

各 GPU 帧率参考（4K）

本表保留原有对比位置，但把没有依据的帧率列换成可复现的设置建议。本站没有与这些数字匹配的显卡实测，也不代填 FPS。

显卡档位4K 画质建议上采样 / 帧生成组合帧率来源
RTX 50 系超高或电影级DLSS 4 质量模式；帧生成单独测试自测时记录显卡、驱动、分辨率、画质档和日期
RTX 4090 / 4080超高或高DLSS 4 质量或均衡模式；帧生成单独测试自测时记录显卡、驱动、分辨率、画质档和日期
RX 9070 XT超高或高FSR 4 质量模式；帧生成单独测试自测时记录显卡、驱动、分辨率、画质档和日期

本站不代填 FPS：我们没有与这些数字匹配的实测，请按上面的字段自己跑一次。

各配置档位推荐

高端配置（RTX 5080/5090，RX 9070 XT）——4K超高 60fps+

DLSS 4 质量模式 + 帧生成开启 + 光线重建开启 + 阴影距离超高 + NPC密度超高。

中高端（RTX 4080，RTX 4070 Ti Super）——4K高 60fps

DLSS 4 均衡模式 + 帧生成开启 + 体积雾质量：中。

中端（RTX 4070，RTX 4060 Ti）——2K高画质 60fps+

DLSS 4 质量模式 + NPC密度：中。

卡斯通卡顿修复

将 NPC 密度降至中、降低阴影距离、开启 DLSS 4。确保驱动版本：NVIDIA 581.29+ 或 AMD 25.9.2+。

绯红荒漠会获得 DLSS 5 支持吗？

DLSS 5 已于 2026 年 9 月 1 日随 NBA 2K27 上线，《绯红荒漠》目前不在已确认支持列表中，但考虑到 Pearl Abyss 与 NVIDIA 的深度合作，后续补丁加入支持是有可能的。

dlss 5 online · ai image upscaler · 4k upscaling · neural super resolution

DLSS 与浏览器 AI 超分是两种工具

NVIDIA DLSS 是绑定支持 RTX 硬件的游戏渲染技术。浏览器 AI 放大器则在服务端处理上传图片，因此手机、Mac 或普通 PC 也可以使用。

在线放大器能做什么

它可以放大照片、改善观感细节、减少模糊，并输出更高分辨率的图片。但效果取决于原图和模型，AI 无法真正恢复原图从未记录的信息。

使用流程

  1. 上传 JPEG、PNG 或 WebP；2. 选择增强模式；3. 对比前后结果；4. 检查人脸、文字、边缘和重复纹理后再下载。

Seedance 2.5 搭配视频超分：更省成本的 4K 工作流与技术方案（2026）

基于官方资料和公开 API 费率，拆解 Seedance 2.5 先低分辨率生成、再视频超分输出 4K 的成本、画质和产品实现路径。

seedance 2.5 · video super resolution · video upscaling · 4k video · ai video cost · BytePlus · RealESRGAN

Seedance 2.5 的价值不只是生成一段好看的演示视频。字节跳动官方介绍显示，它单次生成最长 30 秒，支持多轮延长，可以一次接收最多 30 张图片、10 段视频和 10 段音频作为参考，还支持时间戳级编辑和参考素材编辑。它先在即梦、豆包等产品上线，API 通过 BytePlus ModelArk 提供。

在比较成本前，要先确认接口能力：BytePlus 当前的视频 API 文档把 Seedance 2.5（'dreamina-seedance-2-5-260628'）列为 480p、720p、24fps、4–30 秒输出，并没有把这条 API 路线的原生 4K 列出来。部分消费产品和第三方网关可能提供不同选项，所以“支持 4K”必须按具体供应商和模型 ID 核对。对 DLSS5 来说，视频超分是把官方低分辨率输出扩展成 1080p/4K 交付的步骤，不能写成官方 2.5 API 本身就能原生渲染 4K。

对真正的产品来说，关键问题不是供应商的原生高分辨率效果好不好，而是每次试错是否都必须用最终交付分辨率生成。对于提示词探索、分镜草稿、社交媒体预览和大量 AI 镜头，先低分辨率生成，再做视频超分，往往可以降低失败重跑的成本。

两条工作流

供应商原生高分辨率生成：让具体供应商直接输出交付尺寸。小字、头发、细线、快速运动和复杂纹理需要一次成片时，这条路径更稳，但每次重试都更贵。

低分辨率生成 + 视频超分：先用 Seedance 2.5 在 480p 或 720p 完成动作、构图、音频和叙事控制，再用视频超分模型逐帧处理，输出 1080p 或 4K。这样把“创意试错”和“交付精修”拆开。

工作流适合场景主要成本主要风险
供应商原生高分辨率供应商支持时的最终主镜头、字幕密集画面、客户交付供应商输出 token 和分辨率每次重试成本高
480p/720p + 视频超分草稿、社媒短片、商品视频、批量试验生成费用 + 输出像素费用运动画面可能闪烁或产生伪细节

透明的成本估算

BytePlus 的公开资料按分辨率和生成 token 计价。独立公开费率追踪把 Seedance 2.5 文生视频的 480p 和 720p 示例折算为约 每秒 0.103 美元和 每秒 0.231 美元；真正结算时应以 ModelArk 账户里的实时价目表为准，因为价格和活动会变化。按 5 秒计算，生成成本约为 0.52 美元或 1.16 美元，尚未包含后处理。这些数字只用于比较官方低分辨率 API 路线，并不是官方 Seedance 2.5 的 4K 价格。

fal.ai 的视频超分接口公开价格为 每输出兆像素 0.0008 美元，并使用 RealESRGAN 对每一帧进行放大。按 24fps 计算，5 秒 4K 视频约有 995 个输出兆像素，超分步骤约为 0.80 美元。因此可以得到一个用于产品规划的示例：

5 秒输出Seedance 生成4K 视频超分估算合计
480p → 4K0.52 美元0.80 美元1.32 美元
720p → 4K1.16 美元0.80 美元1.96 美元

这是规划用估算，不是最终账单，未包含存储、流量、重试、音频或参考视频输入费用，也未加入 DLSS5 的服务毛利。真正有用的判断规则是：只要原生高分辨率一次生成的成本高于低分辨率生成加超分，二段式方案就更省；如果超分质量不合格导致重新生成，节省就会消失。

哪些场景更适合二段式

它适合短视频、商品宣传、房地产漫游、游戏概念片、社交媒体素材和内部评审。用户可以先低成本调整提示词、镜头运动、参考素材和节奏，确认镜头后再付费做最终超分。

它不适合特别小的字幕、密集 UI、快速剪辑、复杂人群，以及必须保持身份和纹理逐像素稳定的画面。逐帧超分可能生成看似合理的细节，却让细节在时间上发生变化。因此产品里要提供前后对比，并明确这是 AI 增强结果，不承诺与原生 4K 完全一致。

DLSS5 NVIDIA 的首发方案

第一版应该是一个明确的 Seedance 2.5 视频工作流，而不是一个含糊的“所有视频一键变 4K”按钮：

  • 先以 480p 或 720p 生成预览，提供时长和画幅控制。
  • 用户确认预览后，再选择“输出 1080p”或“输出 4K”。
  • 开始任务前展示预计积分，并分别列出生成和超分费用。
  • 所有模型密钥放在服务端，通过 provider adapter 接入 BytePlus、fal 或我们的 Alphanet，前端不感知供应商切换。
  • 每个阶段原子扣积分，失败阶段自动退回；没有真正开始的超分任务不能扣费。
  • 原始预览和最终视频分开存储，下载使用带过期时间的签名链接。

后端任务图可以保持清晰：'seedance.generate → normalize video → video.superres → persist result → notify client'. 每个阶段都要记录幂等键、供应商任务 ID、预计成本和实际成本，先积累真实数据，再决定公开价格和积分倍率。

我们的建议

先上线二段式工作流，并把它定位为成本可控的 4K 视频精修流程：探索阶段用低分辨率，确实需要时再用原生高分辨率或超分完成交付，让用户自己选择。它的价值在于把 Seedance 2.5 更强的叙事和参考控制，与更节省的交付路径组合起来；不要把视频超分宣传成与原生生成完全相同。

本文为独立产品研究。Seedance、BytePlus 和 DLSS 分别属于其各自权利方。

看完 Aiarty 增强评测，怎样自己做一次可复现验证

先保留输入原文件和处理记录，再对齐局部检查。前后图看起来更清楚，可以说明一次编辑有用，却不能单凭观感证明丢失的细节回来了。

image workflow · entry-point

先保留输入原文件和处理记录，再对齐局部检查。前后图看起来更清楚，可以说明一次编辑有用，却不能单凭观感证明丢失的细节回来了。

厨房样张连接的是空间风格转换：把已有空间画面按目标风格重绘成 DLSS 5 风格的视觉参考，再由 Studio 桌面版承接创作。本文的评测检查方法只覆盖已有图片质量差这一条附带入口，不把清晰化当作产品主线。

TL;DR

  • 保存输入、输出、设置和素材来源。
  • 有真实参考图，才有条件逐项核对细节是否对应。
  • 边缘、纹理、文字、五官分别判断，不合成一个好看分数。
  • 本文用本站厨房缓存重绘做检查演示，没有实测 Aiarty。

这篇文章从哪里来

RedShark 在 2026 年 10 月 15 日发布的 Aiarty 文章带有 Sponsored Article 标记。阅读时应把这项披露放进判断里；本文不转述价格、速度或效果承诺，也不据此评价产品好坏。原文与赞助标记。

工单把它称作评测，我们核对后采用更准确的说法：一篇带赞助标记的产品介绍。赞助本身不能证明每张图的具体权属，也不能自动否定图中展示的变化。需要继续追问的是，输入是否能下载，参数是否齐全，读者能否做出自己的记录。

搜索 aiarty image enhancer review 的人，通常还需要解决一个具体问题：自己的照片会发生什么。我们没有安装或跑过 Aiarty，因此下面提供一套检查方法，不提供购买结论。若你自行测试该软件，可以同时查阅它的使用手册。

先把这次操作说准确

本站公开厨房样例的输入是一张室内效果图，提示词要求把它变成照片风格并保持布局。我们在 10 月 23 日请求了该样例，接口成功返回，缓存字段为 true；随后保存输入、输出和响应，再用浏览器截取本地检查页面。

这是一组确实取到的素材，也是可以复查的请求记录。它没有证明当天重新执行了推理，没有证明去糊能力，更没有测量 Aiarty。效果图本身也不是一张由清晰照片按已知参数压糊的实验输入。

观察整张图可以看到，厨房的大体布局仍可辨认，照明和表面观感发生变化。输入上缘有一小块界面工具条，输出里没有保留。这个变化很适合提醒自己：提示词听起来只改风格，也要检查画面中的其他内容。

如果你在制作装修意向图，去掉界面覆盖物可能符合目的；如果你在保存操作证据，同样的变化就需要拒绝。先写清什么允许变化，再看结果，可以减少事后因为画面好看而放宽标准的情况。

可复现操作

准备一个空目录，使用安装了 curl 的终端执行下面的命令。命令请求本站公开示例，不需要 Aiarty 账号，也没有读取个人照片。

curl --fail --silent --show-error \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"sample":"sample1"}' \
  https://www.dlss5nvidia.com/api/image-edit/samples -o run.json
curl --fail --silent --show-error \
  https://www.dlss5nvidia.com/examples/sample1.jpg -o input.jpg
curl --fail --silent --show-error \
  'https://www.dlss5nvidia.com/api/image-edit/samples?sample=sample1' -o result.webp

先读响应，再打开图片。若响应表示失败或仍在准备，就把这个状态记下来，不要把错误页面改名当作结果。本文素材目录保存了当次响应和文件哈希，后续缓存更新时，你可以据此判断拿到的是否仍是同一份文件。

哈希一致只说明文件一致。它不会替你判断纹理是否真实，也不会证明每次独立生成都会相同。写实验笔记时，把「重复下载同一缓存」与「重复推理得到相同结果」分开记录。

真要测还原，另外保留参考图

找一张你有权使用的清晰照片，先保存未经修改的版本，再制作一个退化副本。模糊、缩小、压缩用了什么参数都写下来。只把副本交给待测工具，输出完成后再和保留的清晰版本对照。

这种安排能检验一个明确退化过程中的已知细节。若手里只有一张旧扫描件，没有原始照片，就只能判断可见矛盾和使用价值；缺失部分到底原来是什么，不能靠输出的逼真程度确定。

分开看四类细节

边缘有没有改变位置

沿着橱柜接缝慢慢看，检查它是否中断、转弯、出现双线，或被新高光盖住。再看窗框角点与水龙头外轮廓。笔记写具体位置和变化，比「整张更清晰」更容易让别人复核。

轮廓旁边新增的亮边可能让结构更醒目，也可能改变它本来的形状。缩略图适合判断整体观感，对齐裁切适合查看局部代价。两种观看尺度都应保留，不让其中一种代替另一种。

纹理是否有对应关系

木纹很容易让人误判。重绘后的纹理可以看起来合理，但未必与输入逐条对应。看重复花纹、方向变化和原先没有的细线；有参考照片时逐一对照，没有参考时就称为新的材质解释。

布料、草地、头发也有类似问题。熟悉的纹理形式容易让新增细节显得可信。你可以说自己偏好某种观感，但不要顺手把偏好写成「模型找回了原来的纹理」。

文字能否逐字核对

标签应当与原始输入逐字比对。处理后突然能读出的内容，若没有独立证据，仍应标为未核实。看起来很像真的序列号，可能比模糊的原文更容易误导读者。

厨房样例里有很小的电器标记，我们没有声称恢复了上面的文字。如果你的任务恰好是识字，应该选一张文字已知的输入；字符变了，就按内容错误记录，即使标签边缘更利落。

五官不能由无脸样例证明

本文没有人脸，所以不提供任何身份保持证据。若你自行测试有授权的肖像，可以分别核对眼形、眼睑、牙齿、发际线和个人特征，再让被拍摄者检查适合个人使用的版本。

不要把这些观察合成一个美观分。一个人可能喜欢新的表情，却发现自己熟悉的特征被改了，两种反馈可以同时成立。没有发现明显错误，也不意味着所有生成细节都已验证。

把结论写到证据能承受的位置

一份能复查的记录应包含任务、输入、设置、输出、检查部位和未解决的问题。本次画面中工具条消失是可见观察；模型内部为什么删掉它，单靠这些文件无法确认。

保留普通结果和失败尝试，不要只留最好看的一次。如果你从多次输出里选了一张，说明选择过程；如果只是取回一个缓存结果，就明确写缓存。这样读者才知道自己看到的是精选样张，还是重复性试验。

下次阅读 aiarty image enhancer review，可以用这些问题判断它提供了哪一层证据。可下载输入支持复现，有真实参考支持细节核对，单张截图则只能支持较有限的视觉判断。

用自己的图片继续检查

你可以从去糊图片页面开始，先确定目的是展示、阅读还是保留记录。原图单独存放；一旦处理改变了必须保留的内容，就停止使用那个结果。

本站增强配置使用 flux-klein 重绘，提供 2× 和 4× 目标倍率，输出每边上限为 1536 像素，尺寸按 16 的倍数对齐。遇到上限会降低实际倍率。这些配置不等于逐像素还原承诺，本文缓存风格转换也没有验证这些倍率。

再看一次本批次实际新跑的增强

我们还把本地检查页的压缩截图提交给 flux-klein，保存了确切输入与完成的输出。这是本批次分享链路文章讨论的同一次任务，这里用它检查评测证据，没有把同一结果算作另一次独立试验。

请求与结果记录可以确认处理的是哪份文件。若你有对应模型权限，可以上传附带的压缩 JPEG，按 assets/enhance-request.json 中的提示词与设置重跑，并另外保存返回文件。先逐字对照标题，再判断纹理。本次输出改变了字母，因此不满足准确保留文字的条件，即使有人更喜欢它的材质观感。

边界与独立性

本文不能判断 Aiarty 产品质量，不能恢复没有证据的历史细节，也不承诺修复五官。厨房样例只展示重绘记录与检查方法。本文为本站撰写，落点链接服务于自有产品；我们独立运营，与 NVIDIA、AMD、Aiarty 和 RedShark 无隶属或合作背书关系。

神经渲染重绘该看哪里：让风格参考带着清楚的使用边界

风格转换能把另一种光照和材质方向呈现在已有画面上。把小字、标识、身份与比例分开检查，才能保留参考价值，同时避免把重绘改动当成原始事实。

style conversion · neural redraw

风格转换能把另一种光照和材质方向呈现在已有画面上。把小字、标识、身份与比例分开检查，才能保留参考价值，同时避免把重绘改动当成原始事实。

TL;DR

  • 想改变的视觉方向，与必须保留的内容分开验收。
  • 完整输入和输出都留下，暂定或失败结果也不删。
  • 先查文字、符号、身份线索和空间关系，再批准使用范围。
  • 本文真实室内记录只支持具体图像观察，不建立普遍保真承诺。

先确定你在审什么变化

这份 neural redraw checklist 从创作任务出发。本文两组记录的目的，都是在已有室内效果图上重新解释光照与材质，同时让原来的空间安排保留在对照中，便于讨论新的视觉方向。

这属于 A 能力线：DLSS 5 风格转换与神经渲染重绘。有效成果可能是日光、间接照明、布料受光或表面对比的参考。能力不由桌面软件的包装定义，也不需要把生成房间说成真实空间的忠实照片。

本站前后对比页提供查看图对的入口。本文补的是一套记录方式：结果哪些部分还能当参考，哪些内容不能直接带到最终设计里。边界说明只有进入具体使用决定，才真正有用。

这两组图背后有什么记录

卧室与厨房都来自 10 月 21 日实际完成的本站 flux-klein 任务。原始输入、返回输出、提示词与任务记录仍在。此次直接复制已有对照，不通过调色或改动内容来制造更明显的反差。

原审阅把它们列为带有偏差的光照方向候选，没有批准几何保真。这个状态随图保留。本文没有重新执行那些模型任务，也不会把接口 SUCCESS 写成视觉验收通过。

房间大体仍然熟悉，但床品外观、挂画及部分柜体细节有变化。检查这些位置，比泛泛判断「还是同一个房间」更有用。熟悉的整体布局不能证明装饰图案或家具与建筑的关系完全保留。

小字要按内容检查

逐字看，别只看像不像文字

标题、电器标签、招牌和界面控件都传达信息。进入风格重绘后，它们也可能被当成画面纹理处理。因此要判断的是具体字符是否留下，而不是远看是否足够像一行文字。

厨房对照里可以看到上缘界面浮层和电器标记。我们没有从这张拼图认证小字内容。需要确认时，打开随包的完整文件，结合已知原文核对，不把生成后貌似可读的内容当成转录答案。

若某个字辨认不清，就写「无法核实」；这与确认字符发生变化不同。原图清楚的字变成另一字，才记录为观察到的不一致。检查表需要区分实际错误与证据不够的位置。

审阅说明留在生成画面之外

任务号和审阅结论放在独立文档里。如果把它们画进图片后又送去重绘，说明本身也会成为模型处理的对象。审计记录应当能够脱离图像中的文字独立阅读。

做展示时，可以在图外说明采用了什么视觉方向。不要让画面中一个生成标签替你证明产品名称或历史事实。即使排除文字的复用，图像仍可能适合讨论光照与材质。

Logo 和符号要核内部结构

标志可能仍然能认出来，但字距、内部留白和比例已经改变。角色设计中的虚构徽章也是如此。对照有授权的原始设计，检查它的内部形状及周围空间，不只凭熟悉的颜色批准。

这两组室内图没有提供经过核验的品牌标志实验。Logo 检查是留给自身素材包含标识的读者使用的验收项，我们不拿无法认证的电器标签编出一次成功保留标志的结论。

生成出某种符号也不代表获得商业使用权。实际交付前保留来源，必要时让负责标识的权利人或设计者确认最终版本。这里给的是编辑审阅建议，没有作法律判定。

身份要单独验收

认出一个人或角色，并不只靠外轮廓。脸形、发际线、表情、个人标记与服装结构都可能参与识别。编辑者觉得很小的改动，被拍摄者或角色设计师可能一眼就会发现。

本文室内图没有人脸，所以不能证明身份保留，也不能用来判断人像工具的表现。处理有授权的人像，应始终与原图对照，并在把结果当作本人形象使用前，请本人参与确认。

是否喜欢渲染效果与身份是否合适，是两个问题。你可以喜欢光线，同时拒绝被改动的表情。对于虚构角色，头盔、徽章、发型和衣服接缝也可能承担同样的识别作用。

精确比例不能靠可信观感决定

一张房间图看起来合理，长凳大小、柜门接缝或窗与墙的关系仍可能漂移。透视像真的，不证明家具放得下。只要决策涉及实际尺寸，就需要在生成图之外保留测量信息。

卧室记录要求保留空间安排，但原审阅仍指出挂画、枕头花纹、柜门布局和部分比例有变化。可以保留它对光照讨论的帮助，同时明确它不足以证明几何准确。

不要把这个观察改写成几何准确率。本次没有校准机位、测量场景或执行数值配准实验。可核实的是图像对照和具体疑点，这些已经足以说明更强的精确几何主张尚未建立。

复现我们实际执行的审阅

  1. 打开 room-run.json 与 kitchen-run.json，读原始任务描述和完成记录。
  2. 完整输入与返回输出并排看。包内既保留拼图，也保留独立源文件。
  3. 对照卧室挂画、床品和柜体线条，再查看厨房界面浮层、水龙头和电器轮廓。
  4. 把直接观察与未核实的小字、未测试的人脸及标志分开记录。
  5. 决定每张图是否还适合作为视觉方向参考，以及哪些元素不得沿用。

我们还复用了库中的 reproduce-capture.mjs，把已有对照放入本地页面并实际截取浏览器画面，保留执行日志与 manifest。这个过程复现的是检查界面，没有制造新的推理结果，更没有模拟一次保真成功。

打开 assets/audit.html 就能看到相同的内嵌对照。若要重复截图，按 assets/README.md 配置浏览器与模块路径，在素材目录执行附带脚本。本包已经跑过该脚本；另做模型实验则需要独立请求与结果，不属于这次回放。

写出别人能使用的决定

一条审阅记录应说明想改变什么、看了哪里、观察到什么、允许用来做什么。对卧室图，可以讨论材质响应，同时保留装饰和几何方面的疑问。笼统盖一个「通过」会丢掉这些具体信息。

文字可以分成与原文核对一致、观察到不一致、清晰度不足以核实。身份要区分本人确认与编辑者印象。比例则区分观感检查和测量。这些标签描述的是证据，不要求所有创作共用一个阈值。

这份 neural redraw checklist 为继续创作服务。结果在某个条件下不合格，仍可能诚实地适合另一个用途，前提是接收者能看到限制。重新说明用途可以，隐藏失败不能代替审阅。

技术背景与边界

BFL 的图像编辑说明介绍文本参与编辑，多参考说明讨论多个参考内容的组合。它们提供背景，不是对本次输出的独立验证；本文没有使用这些页面的图片。

使用 neural redraw checklist，也不能保证文字、标志、身份、比例、商业适用性或时序稳定。本文讨论独立静态风格转换，不是 NVIDIA 运行时效果。我们运营落点站点，与 NVIDIA、AMD、Black Forest Labs 无隶属关系；每次审阅都应保留原始文件。

游戏人物重绘之后，HUD 和文字还可信吗？DLSS 5 风格图投稿前的六处检查

游戏 HUD 传达状态与操作，不只是装饰。准备 DLSS 5 风格的静态重绘图时，应先与原图核对含义，再决定能否投稿。

DLSS 5 · game character

游戏 HUD 传达状态与操作，不只是装饰。准备 DLSS 5 风格的静态重绘图时，应先与原图核对含义，再决定能否投稿。本篇样张只有场景标记，不是已完成的 HUD 测试，下面六处是审图清单。

先看结论

  • 人物看起来可信，不代表旁边的文字与界面也正确，必须分开验收。
  • 投稿前检查状态条、任务文字、准星、菜单、地图提示和场景标记。
  • 找不到可信原文或看不清，就标为无法判断，不凭上下文补答案。
  • 这是独立图像流程的评审方法，不是对 NVIDIA DLSS 5 的故障诊断，也不承诺生成保字。

先分清运行时与素材图

NVIDIA 的 DLSS 5 研究页介绍了以渲染器为基础的游戏系统。本文讨论另一套独立静态图工作流，没有测试该系统。独立重绘里出现文字疑点，不能据此推断官方运行时会改坏游戏界面。

两者相关的对象是游戏画面，以及讨论视觉处理时怎样尊重原有信息。一帧里可能同时有人物、环境、装饰文字与可操作界面。它们承担的任务不同，不能用同一个「看起来更好」验收。气氛成功，无法认证数字、选项或瞄准提示正确。

本文也没有连续画面。一张图不能说明状态条在游玩时是否正常、文字会不会闪动、准星能否跟随输入。目视比较不等于可玩性测试。我们只讨论这张图片是否能诚实承担它在投稿中的用途。

配图究竟能证明什么

本站自有原图是一张霓虹街道中的人物图，环境中可以看见招牌形状。它没有可用来核对的血条、任务面板、准星或菜单，因此不能被当成界面文字的标准答案。它的作用是帮助区分场景细节与界面保真声明。

历史结果中的招牌形式更充分，人物头部处理也不同。我们可以看外观，但原图的信息不足以认证逐字内容。「远看像能读」不等于「与原文一致」，更不能把结果里新增的清楚细节视作从原图恢复出的事实。

这里既不能统计 HUD 失败，也不能统计 HUD 成功，因为相关元素没有出现。缺少证据时应写「未评估」，而不是默认通过。让样张只回答它实际覆盖的问题，才能避免把好看的图片用成虚假的技术证明。

投稿前必须检查的六处

下面是潜在变化类别与验收问题，不是本文测出的六种故障。顺序是审阅顺序，不代表哪种元素在模型里损坏概率最高。

一、血条、耐力条与其他状态条

对照原图看长度、分段、标签与颜色关系。如果端点被修圆、分隔被合并、填充区域看起来不同，就可能表达另一种状态，即使整体仍像精致的界面。这些是需要查找的变化例子，不是本文样张已经发生的现象。

原条不清楚时，不要反推准确数值。有数字标签就独立核对数字，别用条形外观代替文字检查。场景里的红色装饰带也不自动等于血条，先辨认它是什么，再判断是否保留。

二、任务、对话与交互文字

按可信原文检查具体词句、人物名、标点与计数。只保住文本框形状不够，一个动作词或物品名变了，画面表达的指令就可能不同。整齐的笔画也可能只是看起来像文字。

原文不可辨认，就保留无法判断。如果作者另外提供了准确文本，应注明这是额外依据，不是从低细节图中恢复出来的内容。即使知道正确答案，也不能因此保证再跑一次图像生成就能保住它。

三、准星、瞄准框与选中标记

看位置、形状与目标之间的关系。轻微偏移对气氛图可能不显眼，但对一张被当作游玩证据的图片可能有意义。不要为了让比较整齐，悄悄把标记移回画面中心。

先区分真正的游戏 HUD 准星与场景里的高光、徽记或道具，再判断眼前这一帧。本文的审图方法不能证明瞄准准确性、输入响应，也不能说明镜头运动时标记仍然跟随正确。

四、菜单、背包格与按键提示

检查名称、图标、选中状态、格子边界，以及按键与动作之间的对应。看似合理的菜单，也可能表示一个原本没有被选中的动作；新编的图标即使符合美术风格，也不等于原图忠实版本。

既看单个项目，也看整组关系。标签交换位置时，每个词单独看都熟悉，整体含义却改变了。若原图不够清楚，无法核对这种关系，就不能在投稿说明里宣称精确复现界面。

五、地图、导航提示与计数器

关注标记位置、箭头方向、地名和数量。小地图缩小以后容易被当成装饰，但路线或位置变化可能表达不同的游戏状态。若画面还有弹药或资源计数，同样应逐项检查。

未知继续写未知。原标签读不清时，不要根据重绘里好看的地点名认定它是原场景。只讨论色彩气氛的创作者可以限定用途；如果图片用来讲攻略，就必须承担更严格的信息核对。

六、场景文字、徽章与人物标签

招牌、衣服章、姓名牌和装备标记属于场景，却也可能带有设计含义。原图允许时，检查具体文字与重要符号形状。不能因为它们不属于 HUD，就认为换一个符号也没关系。

这一类最贴近本文实际配图。招牌看起来经过设计，但原文字符串没有被核实。因此合理结论是文字保真尚未验证，不是模型成功恢复了某句文字，也不是我们已经证明它毁掉了某个确定句子。

为什么文字需要单独验收

BFL 的图像编辑文档介绍文字与图片编辑，并包含文字编辑任务。但它没有保证本站工作流会逐字复制画面中顺带出现的 HUD。文字作为可编辑画面内容，与文字含义经过验证，是不同的事。

美术参考可以只接受照明，排除文字区域用途；同样的未知放到教程截图里，却可能让整张图片都不合格。区别是图片被要求证明什么，而不是候选图是否足够漂亮。应在投稿之前决定适用范围。

也不要靠一句听起来正确的话修补未知原文。如果另用其他流程替换界面元素，需要披露最终图是合成画面，并独立核对替换内容。这是编辑建议，不表示本站已经提供自动恢复 HUD 的能力。

一次投稿前审阅怎样执行

  1. 保留原图，与候选结果并排，先写清图片要用于什么。
  2. 判断六类元素哪些实际存在，不存在的记为未评估。
  3. 先查内容与位置，再评价周围场景是否好看。
  4. 对存在的元素写保留、改变或无法判断，并注明原图依据。
  5. 拒绝无依据的玩法或界面声明，或把图片明确限制为视觉参考。
  6. 发送前检查图注，区分历史或生成样例与真实游玩观察。

这份顺序面向之后的评审，不是本轮新跑的 HUD 实验。我们没有测错误率，也没有验证某条保字指令，不填写新的生成设置、耗时或尺寸。没有检查的项目继续留空，不把它变成成功比例。

人物检查怎样接着做

已有的游戏画面风格参考主线稿解释了整体创意流程；游戏角色风格工具页提供对应的独立视觉示例。本篇落在前后对比语境，让原图与候选可以一起被判断。

一条诚实的投稿说明，可以写候选图探索了游戏人物的光线与材质，但界面准确性尚未验证。这样保留创意价值，也不要求静态重绘冒充游戏截图。游戏 HUD 首先是信息，美术风格通过并不意味着信息通过。

独立性与证据范围

我们独立运营文中站点，与 NVIDIA、Black Forest Labs 没有关联。配图是授权的本站历史自有样张，不是官方游戏截图。本轮没有新推理、实时游戏采集或运行时测试；不承诺保字，也不把独立样例的限制归咎于 NVIDIA DLSS 5。

博客 / DLSS 5 与 FSR 4 对比

来源驱动的独立指南

DLSS 5 与 FSR 4 对比

DLSS 5 与 FSR 4 都是厂商提供的游戏渲染技术。应比较公开记录的职责、硬件范围和开发者集成，而不是承诺任何场景下的赢家。

以来源为基础对比 NVIDIA DLSS 5 与 AMD FSR 4，区分官方游戏功能与独立浏览器图像转换。

按功能与已核对范围作答

最后核对：2026-10-23

本站主线是独立的风格转换与神经渲染重绘，由 DLSS5 Studio 承接桌面工作流。下列游戏技术资料与本站图片转换能力分开说明。

该用 FSR 还是 DLSS？

对应原问：Do I use FSR or DLSS?

先看游戏和显卡支持哪一项具体功能，再看你的使用目标。对照 NVIDIA 与 AMD 的功能说明核实游戏设置；仅凭套件名称，不能判断兼容性。两者都能用时，应在相同场景和设置下比较。我们没有核实一个适用于所有情况的赢家。

官方来源：https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce/news/dlss-4-multi-frame-generation-out-now/https://gpuopen.com/amd-fsr-upscaling/（核对日：2026-10-23）

DLSS 4.5 比 DLSS 4 好多少？

对应原问：How much better is DLSS 4.5 than DLSS 4?

NVIDIA 将 DLSS 4.5 超分辨率的更新描述为第二代 Transformer 模型，可用于 GeForce RTX 显卡。但在你的游戏、显卡和设置下提升多少，本站未核实：我们没有做同条件基准测试，因此不给性能百分比。

官方来源：https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce/news/dlss-4-5-dynamic-multi-frame-gen-6x-2nd-gen-transformer-super-res/（核对日：2026-10-23）

AMD 会推出类似 DLSS 5 的东西吗？

对应原问：Will AMD have something similar to DLSS 5?

未核实。下方 AMD FSR 资料不能证明 AMD 已有等同于 DLSS 5 的神经渲染产品，也不能证明未来发布时间。请以 AMD 自身的功能与硬件说明为准；超分辨率或帧生成并不等于同类光照、材质渲染能力。

官方来源：https://gpuopen.com/amd-fsr-upscaling/（核对日：2026-10-23）

阅读 DLSS 与 FSR 功能对比全文 · 按目标、显卡与已核对游戏选择功能

DLSS 5 来源

NVIDIA 首发文章记录了 3D 引导神经渲染及其开发者控制。

FSR 4 来源

AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 页面用于 AMD 当前产品描述；具体游戏支持仍需要单独证据。

公平范围

本站浏览器转换器是独立工具，不能标记为 NVIDIA DLSS 或 AMD FSR。

分开记录厂商口径

NVIDIA 与 AMD 发布的是不同产品、集成说明和支持游戏列表。本页链接各自厂商的描述，不把营销措辞转换成跨厂商评分。DLSS 5 指 NVIDIA 文档中的神经渲染阶段；FSR 4 指 AMD 的 FidelityFX Super Resolution 家族；本站浏览器转换器不属于任何一个运行时。

适合真实项目的公平测试

选择一张原图、一个目标尺寸和一份检查清单，先看轮廓与重复几何，再看人脸、文字、细边和纹理。保留原图，记录提示词、预设与后处理。游戏功能要用对应游戏来源，图像任务则在本站独立工具中重复上传。这样能形成可用判断，而不是假设存在一个通用赢家。

把阅读变成一次可复核的体验

先看缓存示例，再决定是否上传自己的图片；官方技术结论与本站独立转换结果始终分开标注。

来源与边界

  • NVIDIA DLSS 5 launch article ↗
  • NVIDIA DLSS 5 FAQ (September 2026; checked 2026-10-11) ↗

常见问题

DLSS5NVIDIA 转换器就是 DLSS 5 吗？

不是。它是受视觉目标启发的独立浏览器图像工作流，不安装或模拟 NVIDIA 运行时。

哪个更好？

没有通用答案；必须固定游戏、显卡、驱动、分辨率和画质测试。

DLSS 5 的画面真的很难看吗？

不能把“很难看”当作所有游戏画面的统一结论，这属于观感判断。NVIDIA 官方发布页说明，开发者可以选择模型并调整结构、色调和局部应用范围，玩家可以开关该功能；这些说明不能证明你一定喜欢结果。请比较具体场景开关前后的角色与画面；本站的风格转换样例不是官方运行时的画质证据。来源：下方 NVIDIA DLSS 5 launch article，“DLSS 5’s Artistic Controls For Game Developers”小节；核对日期：2026-10-26。

博客 / DLSS 5 与 DLSS 4.5 对比

来源驱动的独立指南

DLSS 5 与 DLSS 4.5 对比

两个名称对应渲染管线中的不同工作。DLSS 4.5 重点是 Transformer 超分辨率和帧生成模式；DLSS 5 增加面向光照与材质的 3D 引导神经渲染阶段。

使用有日期的 NVIDIA 来源，对比 DLSS 5 的 3D 引导神经渲染与 DLSS 4.5 的超分辨率和动态多帧生成。

按功能与已核对范围作答

最后核对：2026-10-23

本站主线是独立的风格转换与神经渲染重绘，由 DLSS5 Studio 承接桌面工作流。下列游戏技术资料与本站图片转换能力分开说明。

DLSS 4 只能用于 RTX 50 系列吗？

对应原问：Is DLSS 4 only for RTX 50 series?

不是，要分功能看。NVIDIA 的多帧生成要求 RTX 50；帧生成支持 RTX 40 和 RTX 50。超分辨率、光线重建与 DLAA 的 Transformer 更新面向 GeForce RTX 显卡，但仍取决于游戏是否集成对应功能。不要只凭“DLSS 4”这个总称判断能否使用。

官方来源：https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce/news/dlss-4-multi-frame-generation-out-now/（核对日：2026-10-23）

DLSS 5 会好多少？

对应原问：How much better will DLSS 5 be?

NVIDIA 将 DLSS 5 描述为用于光照与材质的 3D 引导神经渲染；这与超分辨率能带来多少帧不是同一个问题。本站没有同条件游戏基准测试，普遍提升幅度未核实，也不会把厂商演示当成所有游戏都成立的画质或性能结论。

官方来源：https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce/news/dlss-5-3d-guided-neural-rendering/（核对日：2026-10-23）

哪些 GPU 支持 DLSS 5？

对应原问：Which GPUs are supported by DLSS 5?

已核对的 NVIDIA 发布资料确认：NBA 2K27 的支持范围包括全部 GeForce RTX 50 系列桌面和笔记本 GPU，另有 GeForce NOW 云端路径。这里的本地电脑结论只覆盖该游戏与该硬件系列，其他本地显卡和游戏组合未核实；云端可用不代表客户端显卡能在本地运行。

官方来源：https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce/news/dlss-5-3d-guided-neural-rendering/（核对日：2026-10-23）

阅读 DLSS 与 FSR 功能对比全文 · 按目标、显卡与已核对游戏选择功能

DLSS 5

NVIDIA 描述了带结构、色调和语义控制的 3D 引导神经渲染阶段。

DLSS 4.5

NVIDIA 描述了第二代 Transformer 超分辨率模型与动态多帧生成。

如何比较

固定相同游戏、分辨率和设置；不要把浏览器转换结果当成官方游戏基准。

先比较职责，再比较数字

DLSS 4.5 与 DLSS 5 不是通用图片编辑器里的两个预设。DLSS 4.5 文档重点是 Transformer 超分辨率和动态多帧生成；DLSS 5 增加面向光照和材质响应的 3D 引导神经渲染阶段。因此应先对比职责、游戏集成方式和硬件范围，再讨论画质或帧率。

可复现的比较协议

固定相同游戏场景、分辨率、图形预设、驱动分支和采集方式，记录数据来自 NVIDIA 官方、本地 Studio，还是独立浏览器转换。不要把游戏帧率和静态图片转换拼成一个基准。本页唯一公开的本地视频测量是 RTX 4090 参考机处理 3 秒 720p、36 帧用时 87.4 秒；它只是批处理背景，不是 DLSS 5 与 DLSS 4.5 的速度结论。

NVIDIA 表示 DLSS 5 可与超分辨率、帧生成和光线重建协同，因此它们服务于互补阶段。

DLSS5NVIDIA / Architecture Render Upscaler

Architecture and real-estate workflow

Architecture Render Upscaler

Prepare a small render, exterior photo or interior visualization for a presentation. The useful test is not only sharpness: straight lines, repeated windows and the original perspective must remain stable.

Quick answer

Use the image upscaler for architecture visuals that need more pixels. Keep the original perspective, inspect repeated geometry and reject results with halos or invented windows.

Try this workflow →

JPG, PNG and WebP · sign in before processing · 1 credit per task

When this workflow helps

  • Interior design presentations
  • Real-estate listing photos
  • Architectural concept boards
  • Small exterior renders

The result is an AI reconstruction. Keep the original file and inspect information-sensitive details before using the image commercially.

How to use it

  1. Upload the source render — Use the original render or camera export. A screenshot of a compressed chat preview gives the model less reliable structure.
  2. Set the target scale — Choose 2× or 4× in the image upscaler. The studio shows the actual output size before the task starts.
  3. Audit geometry — Check window frames, roof lines, railings, repeating facades and perspective at 100% before delivery.

Frequently asked questions

Can an AI upscaler fix a bad architectural perspective?

No. It can improve apparent detail, but it should not be used to correct a camera or perspective error. Keep the source render and fix geometry in the design tool.

What should I inspect in an architecture result?

Inspect long straight edges, window spacing, thin railings, brick patterns and shadows. Halos or repeated patterns are signs that the source needs another pass.

Is this suitable for construction documents?

No. The result is a visual enhancement for presentations and references, not a measurement source or a replacement for the original CAD/BIM output.

DLSS5NVIDIA / Product Photo Enhancer

E-commerce image workflow

Product Photo Enhancer

Make a small marketplace image clearer before you publish it. The workflow focuses on edges, material texture and compression cleanup while asking the model not to redraw the product or its text.

Quick answer

Use the image quality enhancer when the product is recognizable but the listing image is soft or compressed. Compare the result at 100% and check labels before publishing.

Try this workflow →

JPG, PNG and WebP · sign in before processing · 1 credit per task

When this workflow helps

  • Marketplace listing images
  • Catalog thumbnails
  • Product detail pages
  • Compressed supplier photos

The result is an AI reconstruction. Keep the original file and inspect information-sensitive details before using the image commercially.

How to use it

  1. Start with the largest original — Upload the original JPG, PNG or WebP instead of a screenshot of a marketplace preview.
  2. Choose quality enhancement — Open the image quality enhancer. It uses the fixed preservation instruction and costs 1 credit per task.
  3. Inspect the product — Compare the silhouette, logo, label text, color and small hardware at 100% before downloading.

Frequently asked questions

Will the enhancer redesign my product?

The workflow asks the model to preserve the product silhouette, label placement and colors, but AI enhancement can still alter uncertain details. Review the result before publishing.

Can it make a product photo suitable for every marketplace?

It improves pixels; it does not choose marketplace dimensions, background policy or commercial claims. Export and crop to each marketplace specification after checking the result.

Should I use upscaling or quality enhancement?

Use the quality enhancer when compression and softness are the main problem. Use the image upscaler when you primarily need more pixels and want to preview the output dimensions.

Portrait restoration workflow

Portrait Photo Enhancer

Give a compressed or slightly soft portrait a cleaner starting point for sharing or printing. The safe workflow preserves identity as a review goal and treats every reconstructed detail as an estimate.

Use the portrait workflow for mild softness and compression, then inspect eyes, teeth, hair and skin texture. AI cannot reliably recover an identity detail that was never captured.

Lightroom AI Open Eyes: decide what may be generated before editing the photograph

Opening closed eyes adds visible content that the blink frame did not record. Decide whether that change is appropriate, preserve the original, and label the edited version before treating a more convincing portrait as a more accurate record.

image workflow · entry-point

Opening closed eyes adds visible content that the blink frame did not record. Decide whether that change is appropriate, preserve the original, and label the edited version before treating a more convincing portrait as a more accurate record.

The bedroom example belongs to our core room style-conversion workflow: a style-guided redraw into a DLSS 5-style visual reference, with DLSS 5 Studio as the desktop handover. This article covers only the limited entry point of assessing poor-quality existing pictures; the Open Eyes discussion marks the boundary with generated content, not a face-repair product promise.

TL;DR

  • Missing eye appearance and blurred visible detail are different problems.
  • Reference photos can support resemblance without proving the edited moment occurred.
  • Ask about purpose, evidence, permission, and disclosure before generating.
  • Our bedroom redraw illustrates changed content; it is not a face-repair demonstration.

Keep these notes with the files

  • Purpose: agree what the photograph is meant to communicate.
  • Evidence: identify references and features that remain uncertain.
  • Delivery: keep the original and disclose the altered expression.

The news, with a narrow factual claim

Sina carried an October 20, 2026 report about Lightroom mobile's Open Eyes feature, crediting IT Home. We verified the announcement against Adobe's October 19 post rather than relying solely on the shortened headline in a news scan. Sina's report.

Adobe describes a generative workflow for opening closed eyes and says other photographs of the same person can help with matching appearance. That is enough context for the decision this article addresses. We do not reproduce Adobe's pictures, compare subscription plans, or claim to have tested the feature. Adobe's announcement.

The search phrase lightroom ai open eyes combines a practical wish with an ambiguous word: fix. A person may want a pleasant family portrait, an accurate archive, or a picture that documents a specific instant. Those goals lead to different acceptance rules even when the available editing tool is the same.

Separate four operations before choosing one

Adjusting recorded information

Exposure and color edits can change how recorded information appears. They still deserve care, especially when a viewer will rely on the picture as evidence. Their purpose may be to make already visible structure easier to see, rather than introduce a new expression or a new object.

Do not assume that every button called enhance belongs in this category. A label describes a user goal; the underlying operation may synthesize detail. Read the available description, inspect the result, and preserve enough information to explain what happened.

Reconstructing uncertain detail

A soft boundary may be consistent with several sharper versions. Processing can select one plausible interpretation, but plausibility alone does not identify the original. If a reliable reference exists, compare against it. If it does not, keep uncertainty in the caption instead of replacing it with a restoration claim.

Compositing from another photograph

A real open-eye frame supplies evidence of how the person looked at another instant. Using it can support resemblance, but a composite still combines moments. Light direction, head pose, expression, and the surrounding eyelids may differ. Record the donor image and describe the edit honestly.

Generating unseen appearance

A blink frame does not directly show the eyes behind the lids. Generating an open-eye appearance supplies new visible content. A model can make that content convincing, and reference images can constrain it, without demonstrating that the generated expression occurred during the original exposure.

These categories can overlap in one workflow. Their value is practical: they help you identify what evidence you need and what claim the final caption can support. They are not a ranking of creative legitimacy, and they do not establish how well any particular vendor implements an edit.

Our real example avoids making a facial claim

For this article we requested the site's public bedroom example. The input is an interior render; the recorded prompt asks for a photographic interpretation with soft morning light. On October 23 the endpoint returned a successful cached response, and we downloaded the stored output for inspection.

The output introduces lighting and surface interpretation that differ from the input. Bedding folds and the appearance of the ceiling also change. The room remains recognizable, which makes it a useful example of how broad resemblance can coexist with newly created detail.

This pair cannot establish facial accuracy because it contains no face. It also cannot establish what an actual bedroom looked like: the source is a render, and the output has no corresponding camera reference. The example supports a narrower observation about the difference between preserving a recognizable arrangement and preserving every depicted detail.

A checklist for the edit you actually need

What will the picture be used to say?

Write one sentence before editing. For example: this is a keepsake version for a family album, or this is a record of the expression at that instant. In the first case, an agreed creative alteration may fit the purpose. In the second, opening the eyes would change the very event being recorded.

Avoid a generic permission such as make it better. Ask which changes are acceptable: brightness, crop, background cleanup, expression, or newly generated features. A specific instruction gives the editor and the person pictured something concrete to review.

What evidence is available?

Look for another frame from the same burst, another photograph from the session, or an authorized reference image. Record which source supports which feature. A familiar face in another photograph helps assess resemblance, but it does not establish the gaze or eyelid position at the blink moment.

If no reference exists, the uncertainty does not disappear when the result looks natural. You can still make a creative image with consent, but the label should describe the new content. A visually persuasive output is a reason to keep provenance close, because viewers may not notice the alteration.

Who should approve the change?

The person pictured may recognize a mismatch that the editor misses. Show the original and edited version together, and ask about expression and recognizable features separately. A choice to keep the original can be a satisfactory outcome; the tool does not determine the desired memory for the subject.

For a group image, permission from the person operating the camera does not automatically answer everyone's preferences about their appearance. Keep the review practical and specific to the intended use. This article offers an editing workflow, not a legal judgment about image rights.

What will travel with the exported file?

Keep the original in a separate location and identify the derivative in its filename or accompanying note. Describe a generated expression as an edit. If you use a donor frame, retain its identity in the working notes. Do not rely on a platform to preserve every piece of metadata when the file is forwarded.

A plain-language caption remains useful when a recipient sees only the picture and its immediate context. It should be understandable without knowing the software. For example, say that the eyes were generated or composited for the keepsake version, rather than merely saying that the photo was improved.

Reproduce our boundary check without a portrait

  1. Request sample2 using the public sample workflow, and save the response before downloading any result.
  2. Download the input identified by the response and the returned cached image. Our package contains both files and their SHA-256 hashes.
  3. Open the supplied local inspection page. Compare the ceiling, bed covering, and direction of light before deciding whether the arrangement feels familiar.
  4. Write separate notes for preserved structure and changed content. Do not substitute a global preference score for those observations.
curl --fail --silent --show-error \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"sample":"sample2"}' \
  https://www.dlss5nvidia.com/api/image-edit/samples -o run.json
curl --fail --silent --show-error \
  https://www.dlss5nvidia.com/examples/sample2.jpg -o input.jpg
curl --fail --silent --show-error \
  'https://www.dlss5nvidia.com/api/image-edit/samples?sample=sample2' -o result.webp

Our response is marked cached: true. This procedure reproduces access to a stored example, not a new generation with a guaranteed matching output. If the cache changes later, keep the new response and bytes rather than silently replacing the files from this article.

Notice how much information a caption has to carry even for a room. For a portrait, the distinction becomes more personal because a small change may affect how someone recognizes themselves. That is the reason to establish the purpose and review process before applying a tool.

Choose a next step from the problem, not the headline

If you have another suitable photograph with open eyes, consider whether that original already meets the purpose. If the issue is simply visible softness, examine a non-generative adjustment or a cautiously evaluated enhancement on a copy. If the goal explicitly involves a different expression, describe it as a creative edit.

Readers arriving through lightroom ai open eyes should not be routed into a generic unblur tool with an implied promise of eye repair. Our unblur image page is relevant when assessing a soft saved image. It does not promise to open eyes, restore identity, or reproduce a person's original facial details.

The site's enhancement configuration uses flux-klein redraws with target factors of 2× and 4×, a maximum of 1536 pixels on each edge, and dimensions aligned to multiples of 16. These are processing limits, not evidence that missing features can be recovered. The bedroom example uses its own cached style-conversion prompt.

When reading another lightroom ai open eyes tutorial, look for the original, the role of reference pictures, the scope of the alteration, and a clear disclosure. Those details help you decide whether its workflow matches your purpose without requiring a verdict about the vendor's overall quality.

Boundaries and independence

We did not test Lightroom Open Eyes, compare face models, or produce a portrait repair for this guide. The room example cannot substantiate any claim about human likeness. Keep originals when fidelity matters, and treat newly depicted features as generated or composited content. We write for our own site's readers and link to our own tool. We are independent and not affiliated with NVIDIA, AMD, Adobe, Lightroom, Sina, or IT Home.

Will DLSS 5 Kill Artistic Vision in Games? An Honest Assessment

An honest analysis of DLSS 5 and artistic control in games, including faces, stylized characters, default settings and reviewable before-and-after checks.

dlss5 controversy · ai in games · artistic control · neural rendering ethics · 游戏艺术

The debate around DLSS 5 has been loud, messy, and frequently reductive. Here's an honest attempt at the actual question.

What "Artistic Vision" Actually Means in a Game

When people talk about a game's artistic vision, they usually mean a cluster of deliberate choices made by the people who created it: the color grading, the mood of the lighting, how characters are designed to look and feel.

These choices accumulate over years of development. A lighting director spends months tuning how the sun hits a forest clearing. A character artist spends weeks on a face's micro-expressions. When players say they "notice" when something is AI-generated, this is what they're noticing — the absence of those accumulated human decisions.

The Strongest Argument For DLSS 5

In most cases outside of character faces, the technology is genuinely astonishing. Environment lighting, material response on surfaces, the subtle way light changes as you move through a space — these are transformed in ways that feel revelatory rather than intrusive.

The cases where DLSS 5 struggles are specifically the cases where human aesthetic decisions are most legible — faces, stylized designs, intentionally non-photoreal characters.

NVIDIA's own technology works much better than their worst marketing example showed. The PR disaster was largely self-inflicted.

The Strongest Argument Against

The concern isn't really about whether DLSS 5 can be tuned to respect artistic intent. It's about whether it will be.

NVIDIA has enormous leverage over PC game developers. DLSS adoption is now effectively mandatory for competitive gaming performance. The Capcom situation is instructive: Capcom executives approved the GTC demo, while Capcom artists reacted with visible shock when they saw it publicly.

What Would "Getting It Right" Look Like?

Per-object masking as a default, not an option. Characters — especially faces — should be masked out of DLSS 5 enhancement unless a developer specifically opts them in.

Player-level toggle with visual feedback. A visible toggle that lets players instantly compare the DLSS 5 output against the base render, in real time.

Transparent development about the training data. Users and developers have a reasonable interest in knowing what DLSS 5 was trained on.

Where We Land

DLSS 5 is not a threat to artistic vision by definition. It is a threat to artistic vision by default configuration, current implementation, and corporate incentive structures.

The technology is real, impressive, and genuinely capable of producing results that feel like next-generation graphics. Whether that autonomy will exist in practice is an open question.

A Note on AI Tools Generally

At dlss5.app, we build AI image enhancement tools. Our answer has been: show users exactly what changed, let them adjust intensity, and never process anything irreversibly without their explicit approval.

Before/after comparison before every download. The AI is a tool; the user is the artist.

A mood board for a DLSS 5-style game character: choose references with a job

A character style reference should explain a visual decision without quietly replacing the game character. Choose readable cues, relevant subject matter and a coherent direction; then separate the source identity from the lighting, materials or palette you want to borrow.

DLSS 5 · game character

A character style reference should explain a visual decision without quietly replacing the game character. Choose readable cues, relevant subject matter and a coherent direction; then separate the source identity from the lighting, materials or palette you want to borrow.

TL;DR

  • Start with the game character's identity and assignment, not a folder of attractive but unrelated pictures.
  • Give each reference a specific job such as light, fabric or palette. A whole image can carry unwanted costume and pose suggestions as well.
  • Mixing directions creates a brief that needs clarification; it does not establish a predictable blend or a tested reference-weight formula.
  • The illustrated cyberpunk and anime examples are different historical site-owned characters. They demonstrate selection questions, not a same-character transformation or a new multi-image experiment.

The DLSS 5 connection and the limit of this board

NVIDIA's research overview describes DLSS 5 in a game-rendering context. Our reference-board discussion concerns an independent still-image workflow. It does not run NVIDIA's system, provide its artistic controls or test its treatment of a game character.

The shared creative question is how appearance can change while the authored subject remains meaningful. Here the subject is specifically a game character or game frame, not a room, product or portrait commission. The board helps a creator describe the intended direction before using the site's character workflow or handing the idea to another artist.

Studio belongs to the product and handover story, but a polished product interface does not make an unclear visual brief clear. If the board mixes incompatible expectations, a convincing result may still answer a different assignment. The first task is therefore to decide what each image is being asked to communicate.

Separate the identity source from the treatment references

The identity source tells a reviewer who the character is: head shape, hair, costume, posture and visible equipment. A treatment reference helps describe how that design might be lit or rendered. The distinction is a briefing practice, not a guarantee that an image model will use each input only for its assigned purpose.

A reference may contain a helmet even when you only want its reflected light. It may also show a face shape, body proportion or pose that conflicts with the source. Name these conflicts before choosing it. If the unwanted feature is central to why the image looks appealing, you may need a different reference rather than a longer list of exclusions.

Keep the original identity image available during review. A board can become visually persuasive enough that people stop checking the source. When that happens, the project may drift from restyling the character into designing a replacement without anyone explicitly deciding to do so.

Criterion one: the cue must be visible and describable

Choose a character style reference whose useful feature you can point to. If you want the relationship between wet cloth and reflected light, look for a picture that actually shows those surfaces. A dark thumbnail that merely suggests cinematic mood gives a reviewer little evidence about what treatment you intended.

Do not confuse visible detail with reliable factual detail. The reference can be a generated visual example, as ours is, but it should be labelled accordingly. You can discuss the appearance of a surface without claiming that it represents a physically measured material or that its costume construction is possible.

In this image, colored reflections and dark surfaces can be discussed separately from the helmet. That separation is a proposed reading of the reference. It is not a finding that the model can import only reflections while ignoring every other cue, and it is not a new test of how strongly the image controls a result.

Criterion two: the subject and viewpoint should help the assignment

A useful image makes the relevant character features available for comparison. A close face reference may help discuss facial light but say little about a full costume. A distant silhouette may help with broad staging but leave fabric treatment unresolved. Pick the view that helps the decision you actually need to make.

Consider also whether the reference's pose and body design will compete with your source. A dramatic turning pose can be compelling for reasons unrelated to color. If your assignment fixes a front-facing stance, using that reference requires a clear distinction between the pose you are not borrowing and the treatment you are discussing.

The anime example below shows a different character, costume and environment from the cyberpunk picture. It is not another result for the same protagonist. It provides a contrasting visual direction, useful for asking whether the board is about surface treatment or whether it has quietly changed the entire subject.

A board that includes both pictures should not imply a demonstrated transition between them. A reviewer can discuss their different color organization or surface treatment, but the images also differ in identity and composition. State those differences so that inspiration is not mistaken for comparative evidence.

Criterion three: the board must support a coherent request

Assign a role to every reference before keeping it. One may illustrate the palette, another a material treatment. If two pictures demand opposite approaches to the same feature, choose a direction or state which use is primary. An unexplained collision is not automatically a productive hybrid.

For example, a board might ask for grouped anime-like shadows while also asking for continuously detailed surface shading everywhere. Those can be competing aims for the same area of a character. The resulting interpretation is not something we measured here; the editorial problem is that the acceptance criteria are unclear before generation even begins.

Do not convert a board into a numerical mixture unless the actual tool provides a documented, tested control for that purpose. We have no basis here for assigning percentages to references or claiming that image order enforces a universal priority. If the current workflow cannot express the intended relationship, simplify the brief or use the board only for human art direction.

What the prompt can say, and what the image cannot promise

A prompt can name the subject, the desired treatment and the features to keep. A reference can show visual cues that are difficult to describe compactly. BFL's image-editing documentation explains editing with text and image inputs; it does not certify a fixed division of influence for the site's character tool.

Think of these inputs as ways to express an intention. Neither is proof that the intention has been obeyed. The sentence keep the same face needs a visible source and a later comparison; a reference containing another face cannot be assumed harmless merely because the prompt says to borrow only its light.

The current character workflow leads into the site's image editor with a character-oriented brief. This article does not introduce a new mood-board uploader, automatic reference selector or weighting interface. Use the controls that are actually available. The board can remain a human planning document even when only part of it can be expressed in one editing request.

How mixed art directions can change the review problem

A mixture may lead a reviewer to accept a new costume because it fits one reference, then accept a new face because it fits another. The final image can become internally appealing while no longer representing the intended game character. That is a risk in the review process, not a measured prediction of model behavior.

Separate three decisions: whether the character is retained, whether the requested treatment is visible, and whether the combination serves the game world. A failure in the first category should not vanish inside enthusiasm for the second. When the assignment permits redesign, record that permission explicitly rather than treating it as an accidental side effect of the board.

If you want a hybrid, describe the hybrid as its own proposal and decide what would make it acceptable. Do not call it a faithful example of either original direction without checking. A board can ask a creative question; it cannot supply an answer that no result has yet demonstrated.

A practical selection routine

  1. Put the identity source first and state the game-character use: concept discussion, costume review or a particular scene treatment.
  2. For each candidate reference, write the visual cue you want and the identity features you do not want to borrow.
  3. Remove images whose useful cue is too ambiguous to explain or whose scene does not help the assignment.
  4. Resolve competing treatment requests before making an editing attempt. Keep accepted compromises visible.
  5. Compare any actual result against the source and the stated cue, not just against the overall attractiveness of the board.
  6. Stop when the next reference adds no distinct decision or makes the acceptance criteria less clear.

These are proposed preparation steps. We did not submit a new reference-board task or compare alternative reference sets for this draft. There is no measured weighting rule, timing claim or success rate. The historical images illustrate how to ask selection questions, not how to guarantee a result.

Hand over a board that someone else can read

A collaborator should be able to distinguish source identity, treatment inspiration and rejected directions without guessing. Keep captions with the images and explain which visual decision each one supports. If a candidate fails identity but offers useful lighting, label that restricted use instead of presenting it as an approved character reference.

For the broader starting point, read the game-frame style-reference guide. The matching game-character style tool keeps the subject anchored to game characters and frames. A character style reference earns its place by making the brief more precise, not by adding another impressive picture.

Independence and provenance

We operate the linked site independently and are not affiliated with NVIDIA or Black Forest Labs. Both illustrations are authorized site-owned historical samples with source and hash records. They depict different characters; no fresh transformation, reference-strength test, game-runtime capture or hardware comparison was performed. Their role is to make reference selection inspectable while keeping the original character in charge of identity.

Choose a named interior style without losing sight of your room

A named interior style gives a room redraw a direction, not permission to redesign the building. Specify the materials, light and palette you want, then inspect walls, windows, doors, perspective and furniture scale against the original photograph.

style conversion · neural redraw

A named interior style gives a room redraw a direction, not permission to redesign the building. Specify the materials, light and palette you want, then inspect walls, windows, doors, perspective and furniture scale against the original photograph.

TL;DR

  • Japandi, Nordic and industrial are useful starting labels; each still needs a concrete description of the treatment you want.
  • The site's room workflow offers named choices and a room type. A choice expresses an intended recipe, not a guarantee about the output.
  • Keep architectural constraints separate from styling decisions. An attractive concept can fail the requirement to retain the photographed room.
  • The illustrations are historical site-owned samples. They are not new outputs comparing the named presets under controlled conditions.

What choosing a style should settle

A room photograph can become a visual concept for a different atmosphere. That transformation is the core creative purpose of the interior workflow, rather than a technical exercise in making the original photograph sharper. Studio belongs to the product and delivery story; this article concerns the choices needed before a room concept is useful enough to hand over.

A name helps a conversation begin. It does not settle whether the wood should look pale or dark, whether lighting should feel diffuse or dramatic, or whether the room should remain sparsely furnished. If two people use the same name but picture different rooms, the label has not yet done the work of a brief.

The site's current selector includes Nordic / Scandinavian, Japandi and Industrial loft. Treat these as available directions, not as independently tested claims of stylistic accuracy. We inspected the configuration and the existing pictures for this article. We did not run the presets against one another, and we are not publishing a ranking of their results.

Translate names into visible decisions

IKEA's overview of interior styles presents Scandinavian, Japandi and industrial as distinct design directions. Its Japandi introduction discusses natural materials, restrained color and simple, functional forms. These references provide vocabulary, not a specification for our model or a license to reproduce their photographs.

The descriptions below are editorial briefing suggestions. They help turn a style name into something a reviewer can inspect. They are not assertions that every room in a tradition looks the same, nor promises that our tool will render every requested material correctly.

Japandi: choose what makes the room feel restrained

For a Japandi brief, describe the particular wood, textile and wall treatment you want to explore instead of asking for a generic calm room. You might discuss matte-looking surfaces, woven texture and a restrained relationship between the furniture and its surroundings. The useful question is which visible choices create the intended restraint in this room.

For lighting, specify the desired reading of the image, such as a soft rather than theatrical atmosphere. For palette, name the relationships you want to discuss, such as warm neutrals with limited contrast. These are proposed directions, not tested instructions. Do not ask the image to invent a larger window merely to make the room feel more serene.

Nordic: describe lightness without changing the building

The site's Nordic option explicitly mentions light oak, warm white walls, linen and bouclé, a woven rug, black metal lamps and plants. That list gives you concrete things to review. A result containing pale wood alone is not enough to confirm that the whole requested treatment is present or that the source room survived.

Consider whether the apparent lightness should come from the palette, textiles or light distribution. Those choices should not silently authorize a higher ceiling, another opening or a wider room. If the photograph is dark, a brighter concept can still be discussed as an intention, while the real availability of daylight remains a separate design question.

Industrial: distinguish surface character from structural work

IKEA describes industrial styling through raw materials such as metal, wood and glass. In a brief, translate that vocabulary into a visible contrast of finishes and fittings. Describe the kind of contrast you want to evaluate instead of relying on a warehouse association to do all the work.

An industrial direction does not mean the source has exposed brick behind its plaster, usable ceiling beams or permission for structural alteration. A generated brick wall is a visual proposal, not evidence of what is inside the wall. Keep the lighting mood and palette discussion separate from claims about the building's construction.

The source photograph is the structural reference

Our site-owned source shows an unfurnished room with a rear door, a dark opening beside it, ceiling fixtures and visible equipment on the floor. It gives a reviewer locations to compare. It does not give us measured dimensions, a construction history or proof that every proposed furniture arrangement will fit.

Write structural requirements before considering fabric and furniture. Keep the identity of each opening separate: a door is not interchangeable with a window, and a dark recess should not automatically become an opening to another room. The output may look plausible while changing exactly the feature that matters to someone planning around the real space.

Furniture scale deserves its own check. Compare the proposed furniture with visible architectural landmarks, but do not turn that comparison into an invented measurement. If fit matters, obtain real dimensions outside the image workflow. A concept may illustrate a mood without providing the information needed to order a sofa or plan circulation safely.

Read the historical example as both direction and warning

The site also keeps a historical result associated with its Japandi reference workflow. The result below has wood surfaces, woven pendants, a sofa and a restrained palette. These are visible features we can discuss. The association comes from the existing showcase; this draft did not produce the image.

Look back at the source before accepting the atmosphere. The result introduces a different arrangement of openings, including a prominent left window treatment and a right arched area. The source's rear door arrangement is not faithfully represented. A successful material mood and a failed architectural match can exist in the same image.

This observation limits what we should say about the tool. It can support a discussion of a visual direction, but this example cannot support an assurance that walls, windows or perspective remain exact. The site FAQ also warns about geometric drift. We use that boundary rather than repeating stronger preservation language from older showcase notes.

Make a preservation brief that can be checked

Separate a brief into changeable treatment and protected structure. A phrase such as keep everything the same except style sounds clear, but leaves a reviewer deciding whether a new doorway counts as style. Name the architectural features directly, and leave unknown measurements unknown.

  • Walls: preserve their visible placement and the relationships between wall planes.
  • Windows: keep the photographed positions and distinguish existing glazing from decorative wall features.
  • Doors: preserve the identity and location of each visible door; flag any replacement or removal.
  • Perspective: compare the floor edges, ceiling lines and camera direction instead of judging only the center of the room.
  • Furniture scale: assess plausibility against the source, then verify real fit through measurements before making purchasing or construction decisions.

These are acceptance criteria, not model capabilities that we have proven. If an output fails a protected item, label it as a style-only concept or reject it for the planned use. Do not treat a request for preservation as evidence that preservation occurred.

A proposed decision sequence before another attempt

  1. Choose the photographed room and identify its fixed openings and visible boundaries.
  2. Pick a named interior style that matches the conversation you need to have, rather than whichever label sounds fashionable.
  3. Describe the desired material, lighting and palette treatment in plain language, keeping it separate from structural requirements.
  4. Read any candidate against the architectural list first, then evaluate the style treatment.
  5. Decide whether it is a useful mood reference, needs another attempt, or is unsuitable for the intended handover.

This is a recommended review sequence. We did not submit these steps as a new experiment, and there are no new run settings or timing claims attached to them. The historical example is enough to show why separating style from structure matters, but not enough to establish which instruction resolves a conflict reliably.

When discussing alternatives with another person, compare one decision at a time. For example, ask whether the proposed palette suits the room before adding a new lighting ambition and a different furniture arrangement. This makes the discussion easier to follow; it does not assert a measured improvement in model performance.

Where to continue the room workflow

The existing source-and-reference room walkthrough explains why a source photograph and a style reference should have different jobs. The interior-design tool is the relevant place to inspect the named choices and current limits. Both links concern room style conversion, not a substitute for measured architectural work.

Use a named interior style to make a creative intention discussable. Keep the original room beside it so that a persuasive treatment cannot erase an important constraint. A useful handover says which visual decisions are worth pursuing and which structural questions remain unanswered.

Independence and scope

We operate the linked site independently and are not affiliated with NVIDIA or IKEA. The style resources are cited for background vocabulary; they do not endorse this workflow. We use only the site's own illustrations, not the publishers' room photographs.

No new model comparison was performed for this article. A generated room image cannot establish precise geometry, construction feasibility, daylight availability or furniture fit. Those matters require evidence beyond this visual concept, even when the chosen style looks convincing.

P1 · Practical guide · 2026-10-23

Character consistency after style conversion: will you still recognize them?

Character consistency starts with deciding what must survive a redraw. A convincing new atmosphere is not enough if the hairstyle, costume or face no longer identifies the character. Define those anchors before judging the new style.

style conversion · neural redraw

Character consistency starts with deciding what must survive a redraw. A convincing new atmosphere is not enough if the hairstyle, costume or face no longer identifies the character. Define those anchors before judging the new style.

TL;DR

  • Separate the features that identify the character from the lighting and surface treatment you want to change.
  • Inspect silhouette, hair, garment construction and facial proportions independently; a pleasing overall scene can conceal a failed identity check.
  • Our site-owned historical pair retains a neon-street theme but replaces visible hair with a helmet. It is a useful failure example, not proof of reliable identity preservation.
  • The checklist below is an inspection method, not a newly measured model benchmark or a promise that a prompt will lock identity.

A new treatment, still the same person?

DLSS 5-style conversion is the creative task here: turning a character image into a different visual reference. The question is whether that reference still belongs in the same character brief. Studio provides a product and handover context for this work; the creative result still needs a person to decide what can be used.

A dark jacket, a motorcycle and a wet street can make two pictures feel related. Those shared elements do not establish that the protagonist is unchanged. If a reader recognizes the genre but cannot recognize the person, the scene may work as atmosphere exploration while failing a character-specific assignment.

Begin with the intended use. A mood board can tolerate changes that a costume continuity sheet cannot. A visual direction for a new character has different requirements from an approved character being placed in another setting. Write the use down before selecting a result, so an attractive image does not quietly redefine the assignment.

Write the invariants before changing the style

Treat an invariant as a feature that would make you reject the result if it changed. Avoid a long list of vague adjectives such as iconic, accurate or faithful. Describe things that a second reviewer could point to in the source, including uncertainty where the source does not show enough detail.

  • Silhouette: the outline of the head, shoulders, torso, coat and lower body, including which features extend beyond the main shape.
  • Hair: whether it is exposed, its broad length and shape, its parting when visible, and which side overlaps the face.
  • Clothing: the collar, front opening, sleeves, fastening direction, panel divisions and the attachment of bags or straps.
  • Face: visible spacing and relationships between eyes, nose, mouth and jaw, without inventing features hidden by the viewing angle.
  • Allowed changes: light direction, palette, surface finish and atmosphere, each named separately from the protected features.

This is a proposed checklist for a reader's own work, not a statement that we submitted each instruction to the model. An instruction can express your intention without enforcing it. Keep that distinction visible when handing a brief to someone who may otherwise assume that every written constraint has already been satisfied.

What the site-owned sample shows

The source below comes from the site's synthetic character example. It shows a standing figure turning back toward the viewer, with visible dark hair, dark clothing, a bag and a vehicle to the left. The small source does not give enough information for a detailed account of the face. We leave those details unresolved.

The stored result has a stronger, more detailed presentation of the street and figure, but the head is now helmeted. Visible hair is no longer available as an identity anchor. The backpack, clothing surfaces and framing also need separate review; shared colors and subject matter cannot settle whether those changes are acceptable.

Our observation is deliberately narrow. This pair fails a brief that requires exposed hair to remain exposed. It does not tell us how often other images fail, which model setting caused this change, or whether a different instruction would fix it. We did not run an identity comparison study, and no success rate follows from this example.

Which features deserve the closest inspection?

Hair and headwear are immediate priorities in this pair because there is a visible replacement. That is an observation about these images, not a universal ranking of model weaknesses. For another source, an unusual coat outline or an exposed face might be the more important identity anchor.

For silhouette, look at the outer contour before studying texture. Check whether the shoulder width, coat length and stance still communicate the same design. A change in crop or camera angle can also change the apparent proportions, so distinguish a framing mismatch from a redesigned body rather than treating every difference as the same failure.

For hair, do not accept matching darkness as matching design. A dark helmet and dark hair can occupy a similar region while describing different characters. When hair is partly hidden, compare only what is visible. If the image cannot show the parting or shape, mark that item unresolved instead of filling it in from expectation.

For clothing construction, follow the garment edges. A convincing leather texture is not a substitute for the same collar, fastening and seams. Trace how a strap meets a bag and where a sleeve joins the torso. These checks are useful because costume identity lives in relationships between pieces, not simply in the material name.

For facial proportions, start by asking whether the source and result actually offer comparable views. If one face is obscured, the correct verdict is unknown. If both are visible, compare the broad arrangement and expression before fine detail. This article provides no facial recognition score and no assurance of biometric identity preservation.

A comparison procedure you can repeat visually

The following steps describe a suggested review of existing images. They do not specify generation parameters, elapsed time or output dimensions, and they are not presented as an experiment performed for this draft.

  1. Open the untouched source beside the candidate result. Keep the original available throughout the review.
  2. Read the invariant list without looking at the result first. Confirm that each item refers to something visible in the source.
  3. Compare the overall framing and silhouette, then inspect the head, garment construction and any visible face in that order.
  4. Mark each protected feature as retained, changed or unresolved. Write a short visual reason rather than a general quality score.
  5. Judge the proposed style separately: does the palette, light and material treatment serve the brief?
  6. Choose an appropriate use for the result, or reject it. Do not turn an unresolved identity check into approval just because the atmosphere is effective.

For this particular historical pair, exposed hair belongs in the changed category. Fine facial proportions belong in unresolved because the views do not provide a fair comparison. The neon setting may remain useful as a stylistic reference, but that does not reverse the hair verdict. The categories keep a partial success from being mistaken for complete fidelity.

Reference images and instructions are not identity locks

BFL's image-editing documentation describes editing with text and reference images. Its multi-reference explanation includes character consistency among the uses of reference-based editing. Those are descriptions of an editing approach, not a guarantee for our stored sample or a certification of our site.

A text instruction can name the features you want to keep. A reference can show what those features look like. Neither source establishes an absolute conflict rule for this site's workflow. Do not assume that adding the word identical overrides a helmet, a different viewpoint or a competing costume cue in a reference.

If the first result fails, narrow the creative brief before making another attempt: identify the actual identity failure and remove contradictory requests. That is a planning recommendation. We have not tested a particular repair instruction here, so we cannot claim that this change will recover the original face or costume.

What to hand over with a candidate

For a character-specific use, hand over the source, the proposed visual direction and the unresolved features together. A collaborator should not have to infer whether a new helmet was requested or accidental. If the candidate is accepted only for lighting, label that limited use clearly and do not promote it to an approved character design.

A practical note for this sample would say that the street treatment can inform atmosphere, while the head treatment fails the exposed-hair requirement. That note is less glamorous than declaring consistency achieved, but it gives an illustrator or reviewer something concrete to accept or reject. It also leaves the original design in charge of identity.

For the wider workflow, read the existing game-frame style-reference walkthrough, then open the character style-conversion tool to inspect the site's example and its boundaries. The useful outcome is a reviewable visual reference, not an unqualified promise to keep every feature.

Independence and limits

We operate the linked site as an independent project and are not affiliated with NVIDIA or Black Forest Labs. DLSS 5-style here describes the site's visual-conversion positioning; this article does not demonstrate an official game runtime, hardware measurement or manufacturer-endorsed result.

The illustrations are existing site-owned samples reviewed for this draft. No fresh generation, comparative performance test or parameter study was performed. Character consistency must be checked against the particular source and brief; when the evidence cannot support a judgment, the answer remains unresolved.

DLSS 5 Studio is built around style conversion and neural-render redraw, taking an existing image toward a DLSS 5-style visual reference and delivering the desktop app. Examining a poor-quality shared picture is a limited entry point, not the product identity; the before-and-after gallery returns to the conversion story without making claims about the car.

  • Roadster headlines explain the timing, not the image license.
  • Keep the vehicle reference and processed sample side by side.
  • Record where compression entered the path.
  • Do not claim an effect on Tesla imagery.

Roadster image note: The search phrase Tesla Roadster compressed image points to a practical question: what can a person check after a feed, export, or tool has softened a reference? Our answer starts with the file, not with a vendor promise.

Roadster image note: For this angle, the most revealing crop is not a dramatic skyline or a logo. It is an ordinary edge: a building line, a product contour, or a small region where compression turns a smooth boundary into blocks.

Roadster image note: Open the low-resolution input first. Read a few characters, look at the repeated texture, and note where your eyes stop trusting the picture. That observation is part of the record before any enhancement step is run.

RTX Video upscaling in ComfyUI: make the pipeline inspectable before making claims
